results.title: Obeng Inkoom unseats Richard Asiedu to become NDC Central Regional Chair with an 8-vote difference
results.content: Private legal practitioner Obeng Inkoom has been elected Central Regional Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), ending Dr Richard Asiedu’s tenure after a closely contested regional executive election at Dunkwa-on-Offin.

results.title: 21-year-old Ghanaian Thomas Oduro stabbed to death in North London
results.content: A 21-year-old man, identified as Thomas Oduro, has been killed in a stabbing incident in Haringey, north London.

results.title: Alhaji Bolnaba wins another term as NDC Upper East Regional Chairman
results.content: Alhaji Abdulai Mumuni Bolnaba has won another term as Upper East Regional Chairman of the governing National Democratic Congress (NDC), beating challenger Duncan Nsoh Ghaneba by 220 votes. results.title: Lali X Lola brings musical excitement to Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 at Ghud Park
results.content: The Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 is getting even more exciting, with Ghanaian music duo Lali X Lola adding a musical dimension to the three-day exhibition at Ghud Park, Accra Mall.

results.title: Internet Society of Ghana President urges Ghanaians to be responsible online, warns against social media overuse
results.content: President of the Internet Society of Ghana, Dr Maud Adjeley Ashong Elliot, has urged Ghanaians to adopt responsible online behaviour, warning that careless use of social media can affect their privacy, reputation, productivity and relationships.

results.title: Experts urge Ghanaian youth to rethink their online behaviour as digital risks grow
results.content: The Society of Private Medical and Dental Practitioners has called for responsible use of social media among young people, warning that growing exposure to online risks could have serious consequences for their mental health and well-being.

results.title: Godfred Apasinaba Wumbei ‘Yellow Man’ wins NDC Northern Regional chairmanship with 328 votes
results.content: Godfred Apasinaba Wumbei, popularly known as Yellow Man, has been elected Northern Regional Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), securing 328 votes in the party's regional executive elections.

results.title: Auditor-General to introduce e-tracking system to monitor implementation of audit recommendations
results.content: Ghana’s Auditor-General, Dr Pamela Graham, has announced plans to introduce an electronic tracking system to monitor the implementation of recommendations contained in the Auditor-General’s reports.

results.title: Nkrumah secured political freedom; Mahama will deliver economic freedom – Gyakye Quayson
results.content: Deputy Foreign Affairs Minister and Assin North MP James Gyakye Quayson says President John Dramani Mahama has an opportunity to build on Ghana’s political independence by securing economic freedom for its citizens. results.title: Ken Ashigbey accuses politicians of frustrating galamsey enforcement
results.content: The Convenor of the Media Coalition Against Galamsey, Kenneth Ashigbey, has accused political interference of undermining efforts by local government authorities to tackle illegal mining, alleging that some Metropolitan, Municipal and District Chief Executives (MMDCEs) who want to enforce the law are being pressured by politicians.

results.title: Ken Ashigbey urges Mahama to declare a state of emergency in galamsey hotspots
results.content: The Convenor of the Media Coalition Against Galamsey, Kenneth Ashigbey, has called on President John Dramani Mahama to declare a state of emergency in areas severely affected by illegal mining, warning that the fight against the menace is being undermined by people entrusted with the responsibility of tackling it.

results.title: Ken Ashigbey backs independent probe into NAIMOS-Manso Keniago clash
results.content: The Convenor of the Media Coalition Against Illegal Mining, Ing. Kenneth Ashigbey, has backed calls for an independent investigation into the clash between personnel of the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) and residents of Manso Keniago in the Ashanti Region.

results.title: Samson’s Take: Ghana’s media madness – Politicians created it
results.content: Sam Nartey George says Ghana's broadcasting landscape is overcrowded, describing the proliferation of radio and television stations as pure madness. He's absolutely right about the problem.

results.title: Mfantsipim School has a distinguished place in Ghana’s educational history – Vice President
results.content: Vice President Professor Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has praised Mfantsipim School for its significant contribution to Ghana's educational development, describing the institution as an integral part of the country's formal secondary education history.

results.title: Education Minister appeals to Otumfuo to lead nationwide campaign against indiscipline in schools
results.content: Minister for Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has called on the Asantehene, Otumfuo Osei Tutu II, to lead a nationwide campaign against growing indiscipline in schools, urging traditional rulers to join efforts to restore discipline in Ghana’s educational institutions.

results.title: Vice President urges Mfantsipim to uphold founding values amid changing global demands
results.content: Vice President Professor Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged Mfantsipim School to preserve the values established by its founders while preparing students to navigate the rapidly changing demands of the modern world.

results.title: Mfantsipim@150: Vice President Prof. Opoku-Agyemang urges stakeholders to sustain the school’s legacy
results.content: Vice President Professor Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has stressed that the continued success of Mfantsipim School depends on the collective commitment of teachers, school management, parents, alumni and, importantly, the students themselves.

results.title: Tight security at NDC Ashanti Regional Delegates’ Congress
results.content: The Ashanti Regional Delegates’ Congress of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) has opened under tight security at the Baba Yara Sports Stadium in Kumasi.

results.title: Catholic Bishops’ Conference raises concerns over indiscipline and alleged sexual abuse in schools
results.content: The Ghana Catholic Bishops’ Conference has called for investigations into allegations of sexual abuse of minors by adults entrusted with their care in schools, describing the reports as heartbreaking.

results.title: Ambassador Smith urges investors to create well-paying jobs to curb brain drain
results.content: The Embassy of Ghana in the United States, in collaboration with Region 17, has held a special business roundtable in Chicago, Illinois, bringing together investors, business leaders and other stakeholders to explore investment opportunities and strengthen economic ties between Ghana and the United States.

results.title: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
results.content: Nearly $20m (£14.8m) in cash has been found hidden in farm buildings and buried in forests as part of an investigation into a former minister of Viktor Orbán, authorities have said.

results.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
results.content: US negotiators have touted the idea of Ukraine withdrawing its remaining forces from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for Nato membership, Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

results.title: Surgeon Dr Dakurah enters NPP parliamentary race in Nadowli-Kaleo
results.content: A surgeon, Dr Justine Dakurah, has declared his intention to contest the New Patriotic Party's (NPP) parliamentary primary in the Nadowli-Kaleo Constituency of the Upper West Region.

results.title: Kotoko board unveil Asante Kotoko Ladies for 2026/27 season
results.content: Called Asante Kotoko Ladies, the female team will compete in the Ashanti Region Football Association’s Division One League this season.

results.title: Obuasi Sexual Abuse Case: No teacher will be shielded if evidence proves wrongdoing – Haruna Iddrisu
results.content: The Minister of Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has assured that no teacher implicated in the allegations of sexual misconduct at Obuasi Senior High School (SHS) will be shielded from prosecution if evidence establishes their culpability.

results.title: Mfantsipim @150: Haruna Iddrisu calls for collective effort to tackle indiscipline in schools
results.content: The Minister of Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has called on traditional rulers, religious leaders, parents and students to support efforts to tackle growing indiscipline in schools across the country.

results.title: The 2027 budget is a “common sense” budget – Senyo Hosi
results.content: Convener of the OneGhana Movement and Finance and Economic Policy Analyst, Senyo Hosi, has described the government's 2027 Budget as a “great common-sense budget”, praising its focus on revenue generation, expenditure discipline and economic stability.
